authoredReference.exclusions: Nominal rest head-top marker, not live mesh bounds. Excludes extras, animation poses and status/highlight scale. Research branch predates possession-scale correction.

measurements.kind: manual silhouette extent excluding shadow/HUD; pose-dependent, not world height
manual silhouette extent excluding shadow/HUD; pose-dependent, not world height

referenceFrames.scope: Screen-space silhouette extent only; no world/basepath ratio or reference target
referenceFrames.ballCoreCaution: Ball core, trail and glow not reliably separated in this sample; no diameter estimate.

referenceFrames.observation: Luigi foreground batter and Wario pitcher during contact; different camera phase from Wii fielding frame.
Intro overview crops home and near infield; cannot resolve four bag centers.

ballBaseline.formula: Held: .62; ordinary pitch: .62 + .80*clamp((z-8)/40,0,1); ordinary in-play flight:1.12
ballBaseline.scope: Drawn diameter in nominal game feet, not physical catch radius; pitch helper uses world Z, not measured camera depth. Special visuals and parent transforms require separate review.

possessionScaleCorrection.scope: Stable character silhouette on possession; not a baseball-size correction. New visual baseline must name build revision and include this fix.

acceptedDirections.scope: Readability intent only; no size coefficient, camera-dependent physics, catch-radius change or giant-ball effect. Preserve sim positions and timing; smooth the visual transition into possession.
acceptedDirections.direction: Allow moderate bounded visual size assistance for distant moving balls, with glove-fitting held size and readable trails/contrast
acceptedDirections.alternativeConsideredNotSelected: Use one fixed drawn world-space ball diameter and rely on framing/contrast/trails for distance readability
acceptedDirections.moderationConstraint: Tracking assistance should not read as a prominent growth effect, dominate the character, or cause distracting size changes into possession. Numerical limits remain pending.
